title: 简易银行系统
summary: 维护一基账户余额，支持转账、存款与取款；账户无效或余额不足时失败。
insight: 余额数组直接保存状态。每次先验证账户范围，取款与转账还需验证付款方余额；通过后按操作更新 long 余额。
pitfalls: 失败操作不能改变任何余额

solutions.title: 校验后更新余额数组
solutions.idea: 按操作定义做范围和资金检查。
steps: valid(account) 判断一到余额数组长度
transfer 验证两账户与付款余额，再一减一加
deposit 验证后增加；withdraw 验证账户与余额后减少

code.java: class Bank { long[] balance;public Bank(long[] balance){this.balance=balance;}private boolean valid(int account){return account>=1&&account<=balance.length;}public boolean transfer(int account1,int account2,long money){if(!valid(account1)||!valid(account2)||balance[account1-1]<money)return false;balance[account1-1]-=money;balance[account2-1]+=money;return true;}public boolean deposit(int account,long money){if(!valid(account))return false;balance[account-1]+=money;return true;}public boolean withdraw(int account,long money){if(!valid(account)||balance[account-1]<money)return false;balance[account-1]-=money;return true;} }
code.kotlin: class Bank(private val balance:LongArray){private fun valid(account:Int)=account in 1..balance.size;fun transfer(account1:Int,account2:Int,money:Long):Boolean{if(!valid(account1)||!valid(account2)||balance[account1-1]<money)return false;balance[account1-1]-=money;balance[account2-1]+=money;return true}fun deposit(account:Int,money:Long):Boolean{if(!valid(account))return false;balance[account-1]+=money;return true}fun withdraw(account:Int,money:Long):Boolean{if(!valid(account)||balance[account-1]<money)return false;balance[account-1]-=money;return true}}
code.cpp: class Bank { vector<long long> balance;bool valid(int account){return account>=1&&account<=(int)balance.size();}public: Bank(vector<long long>& balance):balance(balance){}bool transfer(int account1,int account2,long long money){if(!valid(account1)||!valid(account2)||balance[account1-1]<money)return false;balance[account1-1]-=money;balance[account2-1]+=money;return true;}bool deposit(int account,long long money){if(!valid(account))return false;balance[account-1]+=money;return true;}bool withdraw(int account,long long money){if(!valid(account)||balance[account-1]<money)return false;balance[account-1]-=money;return true;} };
